recipe.visualDefinition: A 1970s-style album cover featuring a central oval locket pendant containing a portrait of a woman, suspended by a gold chain against a dark, textured navy background. The layout uses a mix of bold slab-serif and elegant script typography at the top, with a tracklist at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The gold chain creates a swooping arc that frames the upper text and leads the eye to the central locket.
The ornate gold locket frame contrasts with the simple, dark, distressed background.
The warm yellow and gold tones of the jewelry and main title pop against the cool navy and cyan accents.
coreInvariants: Central oval locket with floral/ornate gold filigree
Dark navy background with visible paper wear and texture
Gold chain forming a 'U' shape across the top third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-sized oval locket is centered vertically and horizontally, acting as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The locket pendant serves as the anchor, while the large slab-serif title provides the secondary weight at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the gold chain from the top corners down to the locket, then moves upward to the title and downward to the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample dark space around the locket emphasizes the jewelry and the portrait within.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue with subtle purple undertones for the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright gold and yellow for the chain, locket frame, and primary title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan/light blue for the secondary script text and background highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark background and the bright, saturated yellow and cyan text elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of heavy slab-serif and fluid, slanted script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses extra-bold slab serifs with rounded corners.
Secondary title uses a connected, formal script with a distinct slant.
Bottom text uses a clean, small sans-serif for readability.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The slab serif letters feature a thin inner inline or outline effect to add depth.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, masculine slab-serif with a delicate, feminine script.

preserve: The color contrast between yellow and cyan text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif display style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark navy blue background with heavy paper distress, scratches, and a slight purple vignette. In the center, place a large ornate gold floral locket hanging from a thin gold chain that arcs across the top of the frame. Inside the locket, place a soft-focus vintage portrait of a woman with blonde 70s-style hair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large uppercase slab-serif title in yellow at the top. Below it, add a two-line script subtitle in cyan, centered within the curve of the chain. At the very bottom, add a small, clean sans-serif tracklist in yellow.

verificationChecks: Does the chain form a clear arc?
Are the two main fonts distinct in style and color?
Is the background sufficiently textured and dark?

adjustableVariables: Background color (navy vs deep forest green)
mustRedesign: Record label logos in the corners
Exact facial features of the woman in the portrait

mustAchieve: Realistic metallic sheen on the gold elements

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic gold texture on the locket.
Ensure the script text is legible against the dark background.
Verify the 'worn' edges of the album cover look natural.
Confirm the hierarchy between the two main text blocks is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central vintage jewelry item + dark textured background + high-contrast retro typography pairing.
